notes: WikiText-103 is derived from verified Good and Featured English Wikipedia articles.
Train/valid/test splits already exist in the canonical release.
For this project the canonical train split is re-partitioned into base_train, rescue_candidates, and prompts by a stable-ID hash modulo split (80/15/5).
The canonical test split is held out as the final test partition.

The canonical release contains 241 exact-duplicate articles, including one that crosses the train/test boundary; scripts/build_wikitext103_manifests.py removes all of them before partitioning (docs/data/overlap_report.md).
Raw manifest files are not committed to git (data/README.md); only hashes are. Rebuild with scripts/build_wikitext103_manifests.py against the pinned revision above.
The frozen tokenizer identifier (for optimizer-consumed token counts) is owned by the training config and is not yet pinned; token counts here are whitespace-split estimates.
why_selected: Permissive license (CC-BY-SA) is compatible with ML training and publication.
Well-studied benchmark: positive-control reproduction is straightforward.
Clear article-level structure enables principled mode definition.
Moderate size (~100M tokens) fits a 124M–160M screening model on available compute.
No personal-data concerns; Wikipedia content is encyclopedic.
